deploy-bot: 🚧 Deploy queued: redwood-api @ v2.14.1 -> prod
deploy-bot: Queue position: 3 (concurrent deploy limit: 2) | Commit: 9f3b7d2 | Triggered by: @Jordan | Change window: now
Jordan: Heads up — this is the rollback for payment-timeout spikes. Can we bump priority? :pray:
Maria: Staging canary showed intermittent 500s on token refresh earlier. +1 to hold until we validate the fix.
Sam: What are the two in-flight deploys currently?
ci-cd-bot: Current pipeline: feature/metrics -> deploying (10m elapsed); hotfix/quant -> running migrations (3m elapsed).
release-manager: If redwood-api is critical we can pin v2.14.1 to a dedicated pool (rgw-dedicated-1) to avoid queueing, but SRE needs to approve and run smoke tests.
sre-oncall: I can allocate a temporary dedicated node; need justification (impact + rollback plan). If approved I’ll accept the manual slot.
Jordan: Alternatively I can downgrade to a patch or hold. If we can't get a dedicated slot, please pause it — don't push risky changes during peak.
Maria: Recommend hold. Canary errors look related to token refresh change, not universal but it's a clear signal.
Jordan: OK holding. @deploy-bot please pause my deployment.
deploy-bot: ✅ Action: Paused deploy redwood-api v2.14.1 at request of @Jordan. Queue position -> paused. Remaining queue: feature/metrics, hotfix/quant.
Sam: Thanks — I'll start a small rollback PR for the token refresh tweak and notify QA.
release-manager: Reminder: change window closes in 50m. If hotfix-quant needs emergency priority, escalate via Pager at T-30m.
ci-cd-bot: Record: commit 9f3b7d2 marked PAUSED in release log.
Jordan: If we need to resume with priority later use: `redwoodctl deploy resume --env prod --tag v2.14.1 --priority high`
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll rerun the canary once the rollback PR is merged.
deploy-bot: Queue update: redwood-api v2.14.1 is paused per user request. Queue length now 2. No automatic retries scheduled.
release-manager: Decision logged: HOLD on redwood-api. No pin to dedicated pool applied yet; SRE to advise if escalation required. Will add an entry to release notes.
Jordan: Appreciate it, everyone — will update once QA gives the all-clear.
